description: Update a specification; only supplied fields change, and `null` clears `summary`, `content` or `parentId` (CLI: --clear-summary, --clear-content, --clear-parent). `blockedBy` adds to the existing blockers, never replacing them; it is a second request, and its failure reports in `patchApplied` whether the field update was saved. Adding is all-or-nothing. A blocker that is missing, in another project, the spec itself, already completed, or an ancestor or descendant is rejected with 400; a link that already exists or would create a cycle with 409, so remove wrong links before adding new ones. Children inherit their ancestors' blockers.

blockedBy.description: Ids to add as blockers (CLI: --blocked-by, repeatable).

parentId.description: New parent id; null clears it (CLI: --parent / --clear-parent).

name: specs_update
title: Update specification
